name: @kickside/security-ui
title: KickSide Security
description: Roles, scopes, and policy composition admin web component for kickside/security.

wippy.description: Security administration, mounted by the host as <kickside-security> without props. Roles shows the permissions selected for each role and lets administrators create custom roles, extend defaults, copy roles, and assign permissions published by installed modules. Account role assignment belongs to Users; this component does not change memberships. Run as manages which groups may select a live account as an execution principal, for any component they manage or one selected component. Account, group and component choices use the installed shared pickers. Saving and revoking use the Security API; an unconfirmed mutation must be retried before editing that permission. Standard bridge lifecycle events only (load, unload, error); no custom events.
